title: Lightly Roasted Norwegian Pepper Casserole
description: A kid-friendly Norwegian dish featuring roasted peppers and pickle, made with low-fat ingredients for a healthier meal option. This resinous and molten casserole is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bell peppers into large pieces and place them on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the peppers and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Roast the peppers in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the roasted peppers, diced pickle, chopped onion, and minced garlic.
In a separate bowl, mix the shredded low-fat cheese and bread crumbs.
Add the cheese mixture to the pepper mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
